name: talentlyft-mcp
description: TalentLyft (jobs): search. Every tool maps to a documented endpoint.

platform_mcp_talentlyft_subdomain.title: PLATFORM_MCP_TALENTLYFT_SUBDOMAIN
platform_mcp_talentlyft_subdomain.description: The company's TalentLyft careers-site subdomain, e.g. 'demo' in https://demo.talentlyft.com.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Public Customer API ('rendering jobs without API token') for ONE company (config subdomain): GET https://api.talentlyft.com/v2/public/{subdomain}/jobs with page ('default 1'), perPage ('default 20') and details=true, returning a paging result {Results, Count, Page, PerPage, Pages}. The spec (https://api.talentlyft.com/swagger/public/swagger.json) has no keyword filter (departments and locations take ids), so query/location are not sent — filter client-side. The job objects are untyped in the spec; the mapped names (Id, Title, City, ShortlinkUrl, Description) are from a live response read 2026-09-25, with Country, Department, Requirements and JobTags in raw.
